purpose: Local image processor that generates responsive variants and LQIP placeholders from an original asset.
businessRules: Always include the original asset as a variant record.
Generate thumbnail, small, medium, and large JPEG variants under the original asset version path.
Generate WebP and AVIF variants only when local tooling is available.
Generate a small JPEG data URL for LQIP rendering.
Variant URL paths are object keys; variants are published to the configured S3-compatible object store, and final public URLs are built by StorefrontMediaUrlBuilder.
futureIntegration: This processor can be replaced by an async worker or cloud image-processing service without changing controller contracts.
